verses.text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

segments.text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

segments.text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

segments.text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Shushan-eduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.
